name: TrustArc Cookie Consent Manager
author: Haissam Yebahi

sections.description:
The TrustArc Cookie Consent Manager plugin assists WordPress site owners in configuring and integrating TrustArc’s Consent Management Platform (CMP). This plugin offers a user-friendly interface for adding the cookie consent manager script to the site without requiring any theme modifications.

Why TrustArc Cookie Consent Manager?

  • Easy installation and highly configurable for privacy-first optimal experiences

  • Real-time reporting on consent metrics and executive dashboards

  • Automated website discovery, categorization and management of tracking technologies and potential risks

  • Technical Account Management: Dedicated Technical Account Manager to support the implementation and optimization of your consent experiences and tracker management. Includes managed support, recurring tracker audits, and guidance for customized deployments across regions

  • Benefits: Ensure the best customer experience to improve consents and build trust while honoring and recognizing privacy and advertising requirements

Key features:

  • Automated website scanning – Unlimited scans up to 10,000 pages and including behind login scanning

  • Auto-blocking to drop cookies until consent is given

  • Dynamic tracker display

  • UI configuration interface

  • Custom CSS Support

  • Geo-IP detection

  • Google Consent Mode support and Google-certified CMP Partner (Gold Status)

  • GPC and DNT signal support

  • IAB and GPP support

  • AdChoices support

  • Tag Manager support

Plugin functionality:

  • Configure and inject the TrustArc CMP script

  • Load the banner container

  • Add a Cookie Preferences link anywhere on the site

  • Enable Google Consent Mode Integration

  • Enable WP Consent API Integration

  • Enable TrustArc Events

Disclaimer

⚠️ Important: Installing this plugin does not automatically guarantee compliance with GDPR, CCPA, LGPD or other data privacy laws and regulations. TrustArc provides the tools to facilitate compliance, however website owners are solely responsible for configuring the plugin properly and ensuring that their cookie notice and consent management practices meet legal requirements.

External services

This plugin integrates with the TrustArc Consent Management Platform (CMP) to manage cookie consent on your website.

Requirements:

  • A valid TrustArc license is required to use this plugin. To purchase or get a demo of TrustArc Cookie Consent Manager, please contact TrustArc at [https://trustarc.com/demo-request/consent-consumer-rights/)

What data is sent?

The plugin sends the following data to TrustArc:

  • User’s location: To determine the applicable privacy regulations.
  • Browser information: To optimize the consent experience.
  • Consent choices: To record and manage user preferences.
  • Interactions with the CMP: To track opt-in/out rates and improve the CMP’s effectiveness.

When is data sent?

Data is sent to TrustArc when:

  • The CMP is loaded on a page.
  • A user interacts with the CMP (e.g., accepts or rejects cookies).

Why is data sent?

Data is sent to TrustArc to:

  • Provide and manage the cookie consent experience.
  • Comply with privacy regulations.

Where is data sent?

Data is sent to the following TrustArc endpoint:

  • https://consent.trustarc.com/: To load the script, along with associated images, styles, and settings.

Links to TrustArc’s terms and policies:

  • Privacy Policy: https://trustarc.com/privacy-policy/
  • Terms of Service: https://trustarc.com/subscription-services-agreement/

Important Note: Installing this plugin alone does not guarantee compliance with GDPR, CCPA, or other privacy laws. You need to configure the plugin appropriately and ensure your cookie notice and consent management practices meet the specific legal requirements.
sections.installation:
Automatic installation

  • Go to Plugins from your WordPress dashboard and select Add New Plugin.

  • Search for TrustArc Cookie Consent Manager and Install Now.

  • Click Activate to enable the plugin.

Manual installation

  • Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.

  • Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.

  • Go to TrustArc Setup in the WordPress admin panel.

  • Enter your TrustArc CMP script URL, parameters and configure the banner and preferences settings.

  • Save changes to apply the configurations.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin help with GDPR or CCPA compliance?

This plugin integrates TrustArc’s Consent Management Platform (CMP) to facilitate compliance with regulations such as GDPR, CCPA, LGPD, and others. However, compliance depends on how the site owner configures consent settings, discloses data collection, and manages consent records.

To ensure compliance, verify that:

  • Your consent banner is correctly configured within the TrustArc CMP dashboard.
  • Your website’s privacy policy reflects your use of the CMP.
  • You regularly review your consent settings to align with privacy laws.
  • You implement necessary mechanisms, such as Tag Manager or other consent-aware tools, to ensure that tracking scripts and third-party services respect users’ preferences.

How do I get my TrustArc CMP script URL?

You can obtain your CMP script from the TrustArc dashboard. Contact TrustArc Technical Account Manager or support if you need help.

What happens when I enable Google Consent Mode?

When enabled, the plugin configures Google Consent Mode to adjust how Google services (e.g., Google Analytics, Google Ads) process data based on user consent preferences. The plugin dynamically updates consent states in the dataLayer, ensuring that tracking adjusts according to user selections.

What happens when I enable WP Consent API?

When enabled, the plugin integrates with the WordPress Consent API, allowing other plugins and themes to access and respect the user’s consent preferences. This ensures a more consistent and compliant user experience across your WordPress site.

What happens when I enable TrustArc Events?

When enabled, the plugin will send events using the dataLayer object.

Can I use this plugin without a TrustArc subscription?

❌ No, this plugin requires an active TrustArc CMP subscription. Without a valid subscription, the plugin will not function, as it relies on TrustArc’s CMP script to display the consent banner and manage user preferences.
To obtain a subscription, visit TrustArc CMP or contact your TrustArc representative.
sections.changelog:
1.1

  • Moved the Opt-out Setting from the Google Consent Mode section to the main settings section.

  • Added new configuration for Opt-out Setting to allow users to choose between “Notice Behavior” and “Consent Behavior”. The default is set to “Consent Behavior” for backwards compatibility. Please review the settings on your Cookie Consent Manager before adjusting this setting.

1.0

  • First public release.
  • Initial release with core functionality
